$comment: Forge registry. Every experiment names one metric, one falsifier, a budget with a unit, an owner and a close date. proven/falsified require receipt ids. Validated by src/alexandria/experiments.ts and test/v93-alexandria.test.ts.

experiments.hypothesis: Deterministic lexical routing over the curated tag vocabulary resolves at least 80% of the first 50 real agent needs to the capability a human would have picked.
experiments.metric: share of logged needs where alexandria_plan.recommended equals the human pick
experiments.falsifier: below 60% after 50 logged needs: replace lexical routing with Firecrawl semantic find-tools as the primary planner and keep lexical as the tie-breaker

experiments.hypothesis: A weekly whale-tracking brief built only from receipted records (gmgn-ai wallet_rank + wallet_profile, fiscal-ai institutional-holders) is read end to end by at least three of five pilot readers.
experiments.metric: pilot readers who confirm they read the brief end to end, out of five
experiments.falsifier: fewer than three of five after four weekly issues: the brief format fails; fall back to per-wallet alerts and reopen under scribe

experiments.hypothesis: A receipted pass-through endpoint (one capability, one price, one signed receipt) finds at least one paying external caller at a margin above Firecrawl's per-call credit cost within 30 days of listing.
experiments.metric: paid external calls with margin above provider cost, counted from Polar orders
experiments.falsifier: zero paid calls at day 30: the standalone pass-through has no pull; fold records into the brief subscription and park
experiments.budget: 200 credits of demo calls; 6 hours build

experiments.hypothesis: For one fixed creator brief, a three-lane bakeoff (Seedance via fal, Veo via Gemini, Kling via Higgsfield) produces one lane whose output the design verifier passes on first render at least twice in three runs.
experiments.metric: first-render passes per lane out of three runs, judged by the design-verifier agent
experiments.falsifier: no lane passes twice: hold the routing decision, keep Higgsfield default, re-run with a narrower brief
experiments.budget: 9 renders; EUR cost capped at the three lanes' listed per-render price times nine

experiments.hypothesis: Two allocators (one crypto-native, one traditional) agree to a paid 30-day pilot of the weekly brief plus one bespoke receipted deep-dive after a single call.
experiments.metric: signed pilots out of ten warm introductions
experiments.falsifier: zero signed pilots from ten introductions: the offer is wrong for allocators; reposition to operators and founders
